title: An acidic loop in the forkhead-associated domain of the yeast meiosis-specific kinase Mek1 interacts with a specific motif in a subset of Mek1 substrates.
authors: Weng, Qixuan; Wan, Lihong; Straker, Geburah C; Deegan, Tom D; Duncker, Bernard P; Neiman, Aaron M; Luk, Ed; Hollingsworth, Nancy M
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold Multimer建模酵母激酶Mek1 FHA结构域与转录因子Ndt80等底物RPXKR基序的互作，属蛋白-DNA互作相关但非TF-DNA结合核心，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模。
abstract: The meiosis-specific kinase Mek1 regulates key steps in meiotic recombination in the budding yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae. MEK1 limits resection at double-strand break (DSB) ends and is required for preferential strand invasion into homologs, a process known as interhomolog bias. After strand invasion, MEK1 promotes phosphorylation of the synaptonemal complex protein Zip1 that is necessary for DSB repair mediated by a crossover-specific pathway that enables chromosome synapsis. In addition, Mek1 phosphorylation of the meiosis-specific transcription factor, Ndt80, regulates the meiotic recombination checkpoint that prevents exit from pachytene when DSBs are present. Mek1 interacts with Ndt80 through a 5-amino acid sequence, RPSKR, located between the DNA-binding and activation domains of Ndt80. AlphaFold Multimer modeling of a fragment of Ndt80 containing the RPSKR motif and full-length Mek1 indicated that RPSKR binds to an acidic loop located in the Mek1 FHA domain, a noncanonical interaction with this motif. A second protein, the 5'-3' helicase Rrm3, similarly interacts with Mek1 through an RPAKR motif and is an in vitro substrate of Mek1. Genetic analysis using various mutants in the MEK1 acidic loop validated the AlphaFold model, in that they specifically disrupt 2-hybrid interactions with Ndt80 and Rrm3. Phenotypic analyses further showed that the acidic loop mutants are defective in the meiotic recombination checkpoint and, in certain circumstances, exhibit more severe phenotypes compared to the NDT80 mutant with the RPSKR sequence deleted, suggesting that additional, as yet unknown, substrates of Mek1 also bind to Mek1 using an RPXKR motif.
abstract_zh: 减数分裂特异性激酶Mek1调控出芽酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）减数分裂重组中的关键步骤。MEK1限制双链断裂（DSB）末端的切除，并且是同源物优先链入侵（即同源间偏倚）所必需的。链入侵后，MEK1促进联会复合体蛋白Zip1的磷酸化，该磷酸化对于由交叉特异性途径介导的DSB修复是必需的，该途径使染色体联会得以实现。此外，Mek1对减数分裂特异性转录因子Ndt80的磷酸化调控减数分裂重组检查点，该检查点在存在DSB时阻止粗线期退出。Mek1通过位于Ndt80 DNA结合域和激活域之间的5个氨基酸序列RPSKR与Ndt80相互作用。对含有RPSKR基序的Ndt80片段和全长Mek1的AlphaFold Multimer建模表明，RPSKR结合到位于Mek1 FHA结构域中的一个酸性环上，这是与该基序的非经典相互作用。另一个蛋白，即5'-3'解旋酶Rrm3，同样通过RPAKR基序与Mek1相互作用，并且是Mek1的体外底物。使用MEK1酸性环中各种突变体的遗传分析验证了AlphaFold模型，因为这些突变体特异性地破坏了与Ndt80和Rrm3的双杂交相互作用。表型分析进一步表明，酸性环突变体在减数分裂重组检查点中存在缺陷，并且在某些情况下，与删除RPSKR序列的NDT80突变体相比表现出更严重的表型，这表明Mek1的其他尚不清楚的底物也通过RPXKR基序与Mek1结合。
